info.title: VEKEC LMS Teacher AI API — Design
info.description: Teacher-only AI BYOK. Implemented: admin-managed provider catalog, teacher credentials, course billing, usage and reauthentication. All students denied, including former conversation and recommendation APIs. Generation/worker/release-version APIs remain proposed. Verification adapters: OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic and Gemini; adding a provider does not implement its generation API.

get.description: Active teacher with self-credential capability. Credential operations are strictly owner-only; course billing requires course ownership. Administrators may manage their own credentials or institution billing by policy but cannot reveal or bind another teacher personal secret. Mutations require session CSRF and recent reauthentication. Provider destinations are allowlisted by server adapter. Feature flag AI_ENABLED and recent authenticated session (within 15 minutes) required for mutations. OpenAI /v1/models verification only, no billable probe. Production requires HTTPS. Current encryption is AES-256-GCM with a separately configured environment key. Current provider-secret rotation increments version and replaces ciphertext; old queued versions must be resubmitted.

Retry-After.description: Present when retry time is known.

200.description: Metadata only; never returns plaintext or encrypted secret.

lmsSession.name: vekec_session
lmsSession.description: Existing LMS login session. Active account required on every request.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Session-bound CSRF token required on all state-changing methods, alongside Origin validation.

ContentRequest.description: Summary requires at least one authorized source version. Server enforces course scope on every source. IDs are illustrative until version migrations exist.

AssessmentRequest.description: Non-MCQ kinds must remain feature-disabled until corresponding assessment schema and student renderer are implemented. Answers and rubric are teacher-only.

RenderRequest.description: Only server-allowlisted Thai voices. Storyboard and revision must belong to this course. Stale revision returns 409.

Citation.description: Citations are validated against retrieved chunks and the current reader entitlement.

ArtifactPayload.description: Extensible design placeholder for teacher drafts. Validate per artifact kind before production. No direct student AI access; published normal LMS content uses existing authorization.

DraftRequest.description: Replacement draft payload validated by artifact kind. Editing a published revision creates a new draft revision.

PublishRequest.description: Server enforces compatible kind/destination. Publishes approved content to a new immutable course release or targeted recommendations. Reviewer comes from authenticated actor.

Publication.description: Future curriculum publication reference. Analytics and advice remain private to teachers.

AssistantSettings.description: Proposed private course assistant for authorized teachers only, never enabled for students.

KnowledgeRequest.description: Only approved instructional text. Excludes live assessment items, answer keys, private rubrics, submissions and drafts.

PreviewRequest.description: Teacher-only preview; not saved to a student conversation.

AnalyticsRequest.description: Proposed teacher-only analysis. Server computes metrics and minimizes learner data sent to providers. No student-facing recommendation API.

provider.description: Slug of an enabled admin-managed provider. mock is isolated-test only.

secret.description: Provider secret accepted once over HTTPS. Never echo, log, store in idempotency raw payloads or include in job snapshots. Encrypt with dedicated key or use secret manager.
Provider secret accepted once over HTTPS. Never echo, log, store in idempotency raw payloads or include in job snapshots. Encrypt with dedicated key or use secret manager.

allow_billable_test.description: Only a non-billable models permission check is currently implemented.

confirmed_provider_revision.description: Teacher must explicitly approve the current provider endpoint/revision before sending the stored key. Stale revision returns 409 without transmission.

BillingBinding.description: Teacher owner only, or authorized administrator for institution payer. Teacher credential must belong to the course owner and have a verified current provider revision. Model must be in the selected provider capability allowlist. provider/provider_revision/billing_owner_id are server-generated. Student usage fields are rejected. USD budget governs LMS traffic only; no automatic payer fallback.

UpdateCourseBillingRequest.description: Teacher owner or authorized administrator. Server records accepting actor/time and provider revision. expected_revision=0 only for initial configuration. No student permission or quota fields exist.

ProviderRequest.description: Admin only. slug immutable after creation; expected_revision=0 for create. HTTPS public DNS endpoint on port 443, no credentials/query/fragment. No outbound request on save. Verification uses GET {base_url}/models with adapter-specific headers, DNS address validation and cURL IP pinning; no redirects/proxies. Enabled providers must have at least one approved model. All edits increment revision and require teacher key reapproval.
